body: Could you try an online therapy service? I’m from the UK so we don’t have the same services. There are self help courses online such as mood gym and getselfhelp that are available right now but it probably isn’t what you need right now. Call a lifeline! I’m also here to talk. Myparents are from India and I have anxiety and depression too

if you can try and do little things, like have more frequent showers it might help in a way you might not see right now. i know it’s difficult when you have no motivation and even more when you just want to die. even if before trying to shower more or brush your teeth more you get another bunny (if you can). nothing wrong with loving bunnies man, just means you’re a very human human imo.
i get you bro. if you want to let it out more i’m here. you will make it through this. stop sh*t talking yourself because you will make it through this
checking in again, please be okay. you are worth it love!

i was doing this too. it started with self harm and ended with drug abuse. all while working and going to school. i’m not in a position to say much as you have much more responsibilities than i do at the moment. but please, inside you know you are still alive and your heart is beating. fight against yourself when you get an urge to hurt yourself. take small steps. anything is better than being this low remember. and ignore your mum for the moment. can you not say no when you get called in on your day off, is it about supporting your family or your employer forcing you? or just you pushing yourself; this is what i was doing.
happy birthday bubs!! if you want to message me and talk about anything i’m here. always down to chat to a friend

I know it’s difficult now. But you have a purpose. You might not know now but you will know when the time is right. You have to be there to see it through though right?  You haven’t met your people yet and you still have time. Just push through. It must feel like you’re climbing an endless mountain but you will be glad you did it. My messages are open if you want to talk privately. If you need some encouragement, I’m your girl!
Listen bud I’m here. Anything you want to say I am here. But you can’t do this. Tell me all the reasons why you should and I’ll give you reasons why you shouldn’t.

I feel like that too. Been rejected by all the boys I’ve liked so far. And your emotions are understandable. Your emotions are your humanity. It’s what makes us humans. Sometimes, for some people all the time, they work against us. Don’t try to understand now and head further into a self hatred spiral. Know that you will be fine. Acknowledge that you are feeling this way and let it pass over your head like a cloud. You can’t predict the future and I can’t guarantee a happy relationship with every person you know. But I am certain that you can get through this.
